description: This file is a shell script that provides a command-line interface for managing OCI containers, including starting, stopping, listing, and executing commands within containers. It interacts with a local service via curl and JSON-RPC calls.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts a container using an OCI bundle from the TestBundles directory or a specified path.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby spec JSON file from the DobbySpecs directory.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by its ID.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specific container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a specified container with optional parameters.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the command loop, processing user input.
